{{Youmay|the plant|[[Jai Raventhorn]], or her sister, [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]]}}
[[File:Raventhorn_plant.jpg|thumb|300px|Raventhorn plants on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].]]
The '''raventhorn plant''' was a sharp spiny vine native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|82|raventhorn}}</ref> It had red petals and thorns. Like [[clawthorn]]s, the plant could be found in many rocky mountainous region of Yavin 4.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The plant was featured on [[Klepa Laeel]]'s painting ''[[Raventhorn Plant]]''.<ref name="SWG:P6">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Publish 6: "The Imperial Crackdown"</ref>

==Characteristics==
Raven-thorn was distinguished by the sharp spikes that grew on its branches. Any being unfortunate enough brush into a raven-thorn often came away with ragged wounds, as the spikes were razor-sharp and capable of cutting through clothing and flesh.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Raventhorn_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Raventhorn plants can be found on the slopes of various mountains in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" /> The plant's name was revealed by a painting that can be acquired in the game called "[[:w:c:swg:Painting of a Raventhorn Plant|Painting of a Raventhorn Plant]]."<ref name="SWG:P6" />
